newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.353 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.353 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Tuesday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.353 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for one billion ringgit on March 18, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.376 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.361/335 percent against 6.399/349 previously.
The central bank also announced that it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.323 percent at its auction of 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.349/289 percent.
Payment for the issues is on Wednesday.
